topics.who: Only certified technicians who administer vaccines: ACPE- or Board-approved immunization CE each registration renewal cycle, plus practical training and current CPR

rules.notes: Registration renews every two years (two-year cycle from the date first granted; renewal fee $75) without a general CE requirement: the Board's CE chapter (1140-05) covers pharmacist license renewal, and the technician rule (1140-02-.02, rev. October 2025) sets CE only for certified technicians who give vaccines (2 h immunization) or point-of-care tests (2 h point-of-care testing) per cycle.
rules.rule_quote: Each person who desires to continue to practice as a pharmacy technician shall biennially, on or before the last day of the month that the person’s registration shall expire, pay a renewal fee of seventy-five dollars ($75.00).
